COMMON QUESTIONS

Everything you need before choosing a course.

Still unsure? Send us a WhatsApp message and our admissions team can guide you based on the skill set you want to build.

Ask on WhatsApp
Which courses are available?

Professional Makeup Artist Course, Skin Care / Beauty Therapy Course, and the complete Cosmetology Course.

Do you provide lifetime support?

Yes. Lifetime support is part of the learning experience, with guidance continuing beyond course completion.

Do the courses include business guidance?

Yes. The Business Starter Kit covers planning, products, pricing, client booking, social media, content, lead generation and basic editing.

What are the class timings?

Morning session: 10 AM–1 PM. Afternoon session: 2 PM–5 PM.

Where is the academy located?

Opposite Konark Theater, near Dilsukhnagar Metro Station, Hyderabad.
